Thank you for wanting to improve Meta-XoT-OSS-Rail.

Pull requests cannot be merged here. Please close this one and
[open an issue](https://github.com/morreus/Meta-XoT-OSS-Rail/issues/new/choose) instead: choose **Bug report** or
**Idea**, and describe the change there. If it is taken in, it ships in a later version, and the
[changelog](https://github.com/morreus/Meta-XoT-OSS-Rail/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) says so.

A security problem goes in a private report, not here: see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/morreus/Meta-XoT-OSS-Rail/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
